citable_facts.fact: Swing Digital creates augmented spaces and immersive experiences combining live performance, mixed reality, transmedia storytelling, sound creation and interactive installations.
An augmented space is presented as a physical place transformed into a narrative space through mixed reality, sound, image, performance and interaction.
The XR section brings together Swing Digital’s immersive creations and projects.
The Party is a project in development combining mixed reality and theatre with Pixihead studio.
The Monroe Experience is an immersive story about Marilyn Monroe, built in several complementary parts.
Ticketing is not open yet; do not invent prices, duration, availability or age limits.
